links.outcome: Rater-scored alignment of ChatGPT answers with musculoskeletal rehabilitation clinical practice guidelines
links.effect: Mean Likert scores: clarity 4.85, accuracy 4.62, relevance 4.50, completeness 4.20, consistency 3.85; lower agreement and performance in rehabilitation than disease information.
links.quote: ChatGPT's responses received the highest average score for clarity (4.85), followed by accuracy (4.62), relevance (4.50), and completeness (4.20).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the alignment of ChatGPT-4 with evidence-based clinical practice guidelines for musculoskeletal rehabilitation questions across several quality dimensions, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
